_about: All the text of SETTINGS' help, ABOUT -> FEATURES and ABOUT -> CREDITS (P21, 2026-11-14). Upper case and the original font's characters only; lines are wrapped by the engine. Each feature: name (as listed), setting (the SETTINGS item it belongs to, or empty when always on; then label and values, in the order the engine numbers them), help (green, SETTINGS and the FEATURES list), note (cyan, SETTINGS only: default and the original), and its FEATURES page: what, keys, default, original.

features.name: AUTOMAP
features.label: AUTOMAP
features.help: A MAP OF EVERY SQUARE THE PARTY HAS STOOD ON. WALKING: M MINI-MAP, F FULL MAP.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, WHICH HAS ONLY ITS OWN AREA VIEW.
features.what: A MAP OF EVERY SQUARE THE PARTY HAS STOOD ON, WITH ITS WALLS AND DOORS; THE PARTY IS AN ARROW. KEPT WITH THE QUICK SAVE.
features.keys: WALKING: M MINI-MAP, F FULL MAP, ESC CLOSES THE FULL MAP.
features.original: NO AUTOMAP. ITS OWN AREA VIEW IS STILL THERE, UNCHANGED.

features.name: QUICK SAVE
features.help: F2 SAVES THE GAME AT ONCE WHILE WALKING, F3 LOADS IT; CONTINUE ON THE START MENU TOO. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: ONE SAVE YOU CAN MAKE AT ANY TIME WHILE WALKING, APART FROM THE ORIGINAL'S OWN SAVES.
features.keys: WALKING: F2 SAVES, F3 LOADS. START MENU: CONTINUE LOADS IT.
features.original: SAVES ONLY FROM ENCAMP (SAVE), IN SLOTS A TO J. THOSE ARE STILL THERE, AND LOAD SAVED GAME READS THEM.

features.name: BATTLE ENDS WHEN WON
features.help: A FIGHT ENDS THE MOMENT EVERY ENEMY IS DEAD OR GONE. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: A FIGHT ENDS THE MOMENT EVERY ENEMY IS DEAD OR GONE. WITH SOME ONLY DOWN, THE ROUND PLAYS OUT AND CONTINUE BATTLE IS ASKED, AS IN THE ORIGINAL.
features.original: PLAYS OUT THE REST OF THE ROUND FIRST.

features.name: TRAINING SAYS WHY
features.help: WHEN A TRAINING HALL CAN'T TRAIN SOMEONE, THE REASON SHOWS AT THE BOTTOM FOR A MOMENT. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: TRAIN CHARACTER IN A HALL THAT CAN'T TRAIN THE CHOSEN CHARACTER SHOWS WHY, FOR A MOMENT, IN PLACE OF CHOOSE A FUNCTION: TRAINING COSTS 1000 GP., NOT ENOUGH EXPERIENCE, WE DON'T TRAIN THAT CLASS HERE OR WE ONLY TRAIN CONSCIOUS PEOPLE.
features.keys: NONE. ANY KEY GOES ON AT ONCE.
features.original: NOTHING HAPPENS AND NOTHING IS SAID.

features.name: PORTRAITS MATCHED
features.label: PORTRAITS
features.help: NEW CHARACTERS START ON A HEAD AND BODY THAT FIT THEIR RACE, SEX AND CLASS.
features.note: DEFAULT: MATCHED. ORIGINAL: EVERY NEW CHARACTER STARTS ON THE FIRST HEAD AND BODY.
features.what: WHEN A CHARACTER IS CREATED, ITS PORTRAIT STARTS ON A HEAD AND BODY THAT FIT ITS RACE, SEX AND CLASS. YOU CAN STILL CHANGE IT.
features.original: EVERY NEW CHARACTER STARTS ON THE FIRST HEAD AND BODY.

features.name: START MEMORIZED
features.label: START MEMORIZED
features.help: CASTERS PICK THEIR SPELLS AT BEGIN ADVENTURING, MEMORIZED AT ONCE, NO REST NEEDED.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, NOTHING MEMORIZED UNTIL A REST.
features.what: WHEN A NEW PARTY BEGINS ADVENTURING, EACH CASTER PICKS ITS SPELLS AND HAS THEM MEMORIZED AT ONCE.
features.original: NOTHING IS MEMORIZED AT THE START; THE PARTY RESTS IN CAMP TO MEMORIZE.

features.name: RE-MEMORIZE ON REST
features.label: REST REMEMORIZES
features.help: REST PUTS BACK THE SPELLS CAST SINCE THE LAST MEMORIZE, SO NO NEED TO PICK THEM AGAIN.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, PICK EACH SPELL AGAIN UNDER MAGIC, MEMORIZE.
features.what: EACH CASTER REMEMBERS THE SPELLS LAST PICKED UNDER MEMORIZE. CHOOSING REST PUTS BACK EVERY ONE CAST SINCE, AS IF PICKED AGAIN, AND THEY ARE MEMORIZED WHILE RESTING IN THE ORIGINAL'S TIME. MEMORIZE STILL CHANGES THE LIST: A NEW PICK TAKES THE PLACE OF THE REMEMBERED SPELL OF ITS LEVEL.
features.original: A CAST SPELL'S PLACE STAYS EMPTY UNTIL IT IS PICKED AGAIN UNDER MAGIC, MEMORIZE.

features.name: FIX IN CAMP
features.label: HEALING FIX
features.help: CAMP GAINS FIX: THE PARTY RESTS WHILE ITS CLERICS CAST CURE LIGHT WOUNDS AND MEMORIZE THEM AGAIN, AS IN THE LATER GOLD BOX GAMES.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: THE ORIGINAL'S CAMP MENU.
features.what: ENCAMP, THEN FIX. IF ANYONE IS HURT, THE PARTY RESTS JUST LONG ENOUGH FOR ITS LIVING, CONSCIOUS CLERICS TO CAST A CURE LIGHT WOUNDS IN EVERY FIRST-LEVEL SLOT AND MEMORIZE THEM AGAIN (4 HOURS AND 15 MINUTES A SPELL, LESS WHEN LITTLE IS MISSING). THE CURES GO TO THE HURT IN PARTY ORDER. A WANDERING MONSTER CAN INTERRUPT THE REST, AND THEN NO ONE IS HEALED. FIX AGAIN FOR ANOTHER ROUND.
features.original: NO FIX: CURE LIGHT WOUNDS CAST BY HAND, THEN REST TO MEMORIZE THEM AGAIN. FIX CAME WITH CURSE OF THE AZURE BONDS.

features.name: QUICK BANDAGES
features.label: QUICK BANDAGES
features.help: A QUICK FIGHTER BANDAGES A DYING ALLY FIRST, AS A PLAYER WOULD.
features.note: DEFAULT: OFF, AS THE ORIGINAL: ITS QUICK NEVER BANDAGES.
features.what: A PARTY MEMBER ON QUICK BANDAGES A DYING ALLY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE, AS A PLAYER WOULD FROM THE DONE MENU.
features.original: QUICK NEVER BANDAGES.

features.name: MAGIC ON DONE
features.label: DONE MENU MAGIC
features.help: DONE'S MENU SHOWS MAGIC:ON OR MAGIC:OFF: WHETHER QUICK CHARACTERS CAST SPELLS. CHOOSE IT TO SWITCH.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. THE ORIGINAL HAS ONLY ALT-M, WHICH STILL WORKS.
features.what: DONE'S MENU GAINS A MAGIC ITEM AFTER SPEED. IT SHOWS WHETHER QUICK CHARACTERS MAY CAST SPELLS AND SWITCHES IT, AS ALT-M DOES. EACH FIGHT STILL STARTS WITH MAGIC OFF, AS THE ORIGINAL.
features.keys: DONE, THEN MAGIC. ALT-M STILL WORKS AT THE COMBAT MENU AND DURING A COMPUTER TURN.
features.original: ONLY ALT-M (THE REFERENCE CARD), WHICH SAYS MAGIC ON OR MAGIC OFF ON THE BOTTOM LINE AS IT SWITCHES.

features.name: TARGETING SKIPS THE PARTY
features.label: KEEP AIM ON FOES
features.help: IN AIM, NEXT AND PREV STEP THROUGH THE ENEMIES ONLY FOR ATTACKS AND HARMFUL SPELLS.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, NEXT AND PREV STEP THROUGH EVERY FIGURE.
features.what: WHEN AIMING AN ATTACK OR A HARMFUL SPELL, THE AIM STARTS ON THE NEAREST ENEMY AND NEXT AND PREV STEP THROUGH THE ENEMIES ONLY, NEAREST FIRST. A HELPFUL SPELL STEPS THROUGH THE PARTY FIRST, THEN THE ENEMIES. MANUAL STILL REACHES ANY SQUARE.
features.keys: NEXT, PREV AND MANUAL IN AIM, AS BEFORE.
features.original: THE AIM STARTS ON THE ONE WHOSE TURN IT IS; NEXT AND PREV STEP THROUGH EVERY FIGURE IN SIGHT, THE PARTY'S TOO.

features.name: TACTICS FOR QUICK
features.label: TACTICS FOR QUICK
features.help: SMARTER: QUICK HEALS, AIMS AT THE WEAKEST, SAVES ITS SPELLS AND FLEES A HOPELESS FIGHT.
features.note: DEFAULT: ORIGINAL, AS THE ORIGINAL'S QUICK.
features.what: SMARTER: THE PARTY'S QUICK MEMBERS BANDAGE AND HEAL, WASTE NO SPELLS, GO FOR THE WEAKEST ENEMY, KEEP OUT OF REACH WHEN BADLY HURT, AND THE PARTY FLEES A HOPELESS FIGHT.
features.original: QUICK PICKS TARGETS AND SPELLS AT RANDOM AND NEVER HEALS.

features.name: ORDERS
features.help: WITH TACTICS FOR QUICK SMARTER, VIEW HAS ORDER: FREE, NO SPELLS, MELEE, STAND OR HEAL.
features.what: A STANDING ORDER FOR EACH CHARACTER ON QUICK: FREE, NO SPELLS, MELEE ONLY, STAND (NEVER MOVES) OR HEAL (HEALS FIRST, NO ATTACK SPELLS).
features.default: FREE. ONLY THERE WHEN TACTICS FOR QUICK IS SMARTER.
features.original: NO ORDERS.

features.name: MONSTER TACTICS
features.label: MONSTER TACTICS
features.help: HOW HARD FIGHTS ARE. SMARTER: MONSTERS HEAL, SPARE THEIR OWN SIDE, GO FOR CASTERS.
features.what: A DIFFICULTY OPTION. SMARTER: MONSTERS HEAL, PLACE AREA SPELLS TO SPARE THEIR OWN SIDE, AND GO FOR SPELLCASTERS, THEN THE WEAKEST.
features.original: MONSTERS PICK TARGETS AND SPELLS AT RANDOM.

features.name: EVENT TEXT APPEARS AT ONCE
features.help: AN EVENT'S TEXT IS SHOWN WHOLE AT ONCE. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: WHEN THE PARTY MEETS AN EVENT, ITS TEXT APPEARS ALL AT ONCE INSTEAD OF BEING TYPED OUT.
features.original: TYPES AN EVENT'S TEXT OUT LETTER BY LETTER.

features.name: SOUND
features.label: BEEPS
features.help: THE ORIGINAL'S PC-SPEAKER SOUNDS: A BLOW THAT LANDS, A MISS, AND THE REST AS THE ORIGINAL PLAYS THEM.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. THE ORIGINAL PLAYED THEM ON THE PC SPEAKER (OR A TANDY'S SOUND CHIP, NOT HERE).
features.what: THE GAME'S OWN SOUNDS, MADE THE WAY THE ORIGINAL MADE THEM: ITS SOUND DRIVER RUN ON THE GAME'S OWN DATA, PLAYED AS THE PC SPEAKER'S SQUARE WAVE. THE CHOICE IS REMEMBERED.
features.original: THE SAME SOUNDS ON THE PC SPEAKER (A TANDY'S THREE VOICES ARE NOT PLAYED HERE). IN A FIGHT THE ORIGINAL HOLDS THE GAME FOR A TENTH OF A SECOND WHILE EACH SOUND PLAYS; HERE THE SOUND STOPS AT THE SAME MOMENT BUT THE GAME DOESN'T WAIT.

features.name: ARROWS IN WHO LISTS
features.help: IN A WHO LIST (WHO WILL PAY? AND THE OTHERS) UP AND DOWN MOVE THE CHOICE, AS HOME AND END DO.
features.what: WHEN THE GAME ASKS WHO (WHO WILL PAY?, WHO WILL CHALLENGE? AND THE OTHER WHO LISTS), THE UP AND DOWN ARROWS MOVE THE CHOICE THROUGH THE PARTY AS HOME AND END DO. NOTHING ELSE CHANGES.
features.keys: UP AND DOWN IN A WHO LIST.
features.original: ONLY HOME AND END MOVE THE CHOICE; UP AND DOWN DO NOTHING.

features.name: MOUSE
features.label: USE MOUSE
features.help: CLICK A MENU WORD TO CHOOSE IT, AS ITS LETTER DOES; CLICK A LIST LINE TO LIGHT IT, DOUBLE CLICK TO TAKE IT. RIGHT BUTTON: ESC. WHEEL: UP AND DOWN.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: KEYS ONLY, AS THE ORIGINAL, WHICH READ NO MOUSE.
features.what: THE MOUSE DOES WHAT A KEY DOES, NOTHING MORE. A MENU WORD ON THE BOTTOM LINE LIGHTS UNDER THE POINTER AND A CLICK CHOOSES IT, AS PRESSING ITS WHITE LETTER DOES. A CLICK ON A LINE OF A LIST (ITEMS, SPELLS, THE SHOP, THE PARTY WHERE YOU CHOOSE WHO, SETTINGS, FEATURES) LIGHTS IT AS THE ARROWS WOULD; A DOUBLE CLICK ON THE LIT LINE TAKES IT (THE FIRST MENU WORD: BUY, TAKE, VIEW...). THE RIGHT BUTTON IS ESC; THE WHEEL IS UP AND DOWN. WALKING, A CLICK IN THE VIEW MOVES: THE LEFT THIRD TURNS LEFT, THE RIGHT THIRD TURNS RIGHT, THE MIDDLE STEPS FORWARD, THE BOTTOM STRIP STEPS BACK (ON THE WILDERNESS MAP, THE SIDE CLICKED IS THE WAY STEPPED). IN COMBAT, A CLICK ON A SQUARE NEXT TO THE ONE WHOSE TURN IT IS STEPS THERE; IN AIM A CLICK AIMS AT A SQUARE, AND A CLICK ON THE SQUARE AIMED AT IS TARGET. THE CHOICE IS REMEMBERED.
features.keys: LEFT BUTTON ON A MENU WORD, A LIST LINE (TWICE TO TAKE IT), THE VIEW OR THE BATTLEFIELD; RIGHT BUTTON, WHEEL. SETTINGS: U (USE MOUSE).
features.original: KEYS ONLY: THE DOS VERSION READS NO MOUSE.

features.name: QUEST LOG
features.label: QUEST LOG
features.help: Q WHILE WALKING LISTS THE QUESTS THE PARTY KNOWS: OPEN, DONE AND REPORTED.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, NO LIST; Q DOES NOTHING.
features.what: Q WHILE WALKING OPENS A LIST OF THE QUESTS THE PARTY HAS HEARD OF: THE OPEN ONES FIRST, THEN THOSE DONE AND WAITING TO BE REPORTED AT CITY HALL; THE REPORTED ONES FOLD INTO ONE LINE. VIEW SHOWS A QUEST: WHO GAVE IT, WHERE, THE STEPS DONE SO FAR AND THE OFFER. TO KEEP SURPRISES, A STEP SHOWS ONLY ONCE DONE, AND WHERE ONLY AFTER THE OFFER WAS HEARD.
features.keys: Q WHILE WALKING; UP AND DOWN, VIEW, NEXT, PREV; ESC, E OR Q TO CLOSE.
features.original: NO LIST: THE COUNCIL'S CLERK READS THE COMMISSIONS ONCE, AND THE PLAYER KEEPS NOTES.

features.name: SAVE LIST
features.label: LIST OF SAVES
features.help: SAVE AND LOAD SHOW THE SAVED GAMES AS A LIST: WHERE, WHEN, THE PARTY AND YOUR OWN NAME FOR EACH. A LETTER STILL TAKES ITS SLOT AT ONCE.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, WHICH ASKS ONLY FOR A LETTER A TO J.
features.what: ENCAMP SAVE, THE PARTY MENU'S SAVE CURRENT GAME AND THE START MENU'S LOAD SAVED GAME SHOW SLOTS A TO J AS A LIST: THE AREA, THE SQUARE AND FACING, AND THE GAME'S DAY AND TIME. THE LIT SLOT SHOWS ITS NAME, WHEN IT WAS SAVED, WHETHER THE AUTOMAP COMES WITH IT, AND THE PARTY WITH THEIR HIT POINTS. NAME GIVES THE LIT SLOT A NAME OF YOUR OWN, UP TO 24 LETTERS, KEPT IN THIS GAME'S OWN FILE BESIDE THE SAVE. SAVING A SLOT AGAIN CLEARS ITS NAME. LOAD ALSO LISTS THE QUICK SAVE (Q).
features.keys: A TO J SAVE OR LOAD THAT SLOT AT ONCE, AS IN THE ORIGINAL (SO E IS SLOT E: ESC LEAVES). UP AND DOWN LIGHT A SLOT; S OR L TAKES IT, N NAMES IT. LOAD: Q THE QUICK SAVE.
features.original: SAVE WHICH GAME: A TO J, AND LOAD WHICH GAME? WITH THE LETTERS IN USE; NOTHING SAYS WHAT A SLOT HOLDS.

features.name: SPELL AREA
features.label: SHOW SPELL AREA
features.help: WHILE AIMING A FIREBALL, SLEEP OR OTHER AREA SPELL, THE FLOOR OF EVERY SQUARE IT WOULD CATCH IS SHADED IN THE SPELL'S COLOUR.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, ONLY THE AIM BOX.
features.what: WHILE AN AREA SPELL IS AIMED, EVERY SQUARE IT WOULD CATCH HAS ITS FLOOR SHADED IN THE SPELL'S COLOUR: RED FOR FIREBALL AND BURNING HANDS, BLUE FOR SLEEP, GREEN FOR STINKING CLOUD, MAGENTA FOR THE REST. LIGHTNING BOLT SHOWS ITS LINE. THE FIGURES STAY AS THEY ARE, SO YOU SEE AT A GLANCE WHO IS CAUGHT, FRIENDS TOO. THE SHADING MOVES WITH THE AIM.
features.original: ONLY THE AIM BOX ON THE SQUARE AIMED AT; NOTHING SHOWS WHICH SQUARES THE SPELL WILL CATCH.

features.name: FULL SCREEN
features.label: FULL SCREEN
features.help: THE GAME FILLS THE SCREEN, KEEPING ITS SHAPE AND SHARP PIXELS. ALT+ENTER OR F11 SWITCHES IT ANYWHERE.
features.note: DEFAULT: OFF (A WINDOW). THE ORIGINAL RAN FULL SCREEN UNDER DOS; DOSBOX SWITCHES WITH ALT+ENTER.
features.what: THE GAME FILLS THE SCREEN. THE PICTURE KEEPS ITS SHAPE, WITH BLACK BARS AT THE SIDES OR TOP AND BOTTOM, AND ITS PIXELS STAY SHARP. THE CHOICE IS REMEMBERED.
features.keys: ALT+ENTER OR F11, ON ANY SCREEN. SETTINGS: F.
features.original: A DOS GAME, FULL SCREEN BY NATURE; UNDER DOSBOX ALT+ENTER SWITCHES IT. THE GAME ITSELF READS NEITHER KEY.

features.name: ORIGINAL'S BUGS
features.label: ORIGINAL'S BUGS
features.help: ON: THE GAME KEEPS THE ORIGINAL'S BUGS. OFF: THE BUGS WE KNOW OF ARE FIXED, EACH ONE AS ITS FIX LANDS.
features.what: THE ORIGINAL HAS BUGS THAT CHANGE PLAY. WITH THIS OFF, EACH ONE FOUND AND FIXED PLAYS AS THE RULES MEANT. THE LIST SO FAR: MAGIC MISSILE AT LEVEL 1 DOES NOTHING; SPELL: THE FIRST MEMBER CASTS KNOCK; CLOCK ADDS AN UNSET COUNT; PARTY CHECK WRITES A STACK BYTE; A SPOILED SPELL LEAVES THE ATTACKER'S MEMORY; THE WILDERNESS FIELD'S UNSET TERRAIN; MAGIC RESISTANCE WRAPS; DOUBLE LEVEL DRAIN; SHARE WITH AN OVERLOADED MEMBER; THE CACHED LOAD GOES STALE; PARTY STRENGTH WRAPS; CHARISMA BELOW 3 PARLEY BONUS; PROTECTION FROM EVIL'S TO-HIT. NO FIX HAS LANDED YET: FOR NOW BOTH SETTINGS PLAY AS THE ORIGINAL.
features.original: ALL OF THEM, ALWAYS.

features.name: RECORD MY GAME
features.label: RECORD MY GAME
features.help: ON: EACH GAME YOU LOAD OR START IS RECORDED, KEY BY KEY, SO A BUG REPORT CAN BE REPLAYED EXACTLY.
features.note: DEFAULT: OFF. THE FILES GO TO THE GAME'S USER FOLDER, RECORDINGS.
features.what: WHILE ON, EVERY GAME LOADED OR STARTED WRITES A FILE WITH THE STARTING SAVE, THE DICE SEED, THE SETTINGS AND EVERY KEY PRESSED WITH ITS TIME (NOT THE MOUSE YET). ON WINDOWS THE FILES ARE IN %APPDATA%\GODOT\APP_USERDATA\GOLD BOX REFORGED\RECORDINGS. ATTACH ONE TO A BUG REPORT.
features.original: NONE.
